entries.rationale: The Peeters issue record and publisher-hosted first-page preview identify this as an article by Geoffrey Herman and supply its volume, pages, DOI and abstract; the imported row was typed as a chapter and contained a corrupted citation with the following bibliography entry appended.

before.title: An Unpublished Incantation Bowl with a Citation from Isaiah 40
before.citation: Herman, Geoffrey. “ An Unpublished Incantation Bowl with a Citation from Isaiah 40.” Semitica 63 (2021): 349–53. 44 Aramaic Incantation Bowls Hunter, Erica C. D. “Combat and Conflict in Incantation Bowls: Studies on Two Aramaic Specimens from Nippur.” In Studia Aramaica: New Sources and New Approaches, ed. Markham J. Geller, Jonas C. Greenfield, and Michael P. Weitzman, 61–75. Oxford: Oxford University Press, 1995.
before.notes: Citation transcribed verbatim from Waller 2025, list of JBA bowl publications, printed pp. 40-47 (SRC-19F191B3F5C5, archive SHA-256 b60b030f13d2...). Not independently verified against the publication itself; title and type are parsed from the citation and may need correction.

after.title: An Unpublished Incantation Bowl with a Citation from Isaiah 40
after.citation: Herman, Geoffrey. ‘An Unpublished Incantation Bowl with a Citation from Isaiah 40.’ Semitica 63 (2021): 349-353. https://doi.org/10.2143/SE.63.0.3289909.
after.notes: Bibliographic metadata and the first-page abstract were verified against Peeters on 19 September 2026. The abstract states that the article first publishes one Jewish Babylonian Aramaic bowl containing a Hebrew citation of Isaiah 40:6-8; no protected article text was imported.
